data.label: Networking & Protocol Analysis
data.description: Understand the 7 layers of the OSI model, TCP 3-way handshake, Wireshark packet dissection, subnetting (CIDR), and DNS/TLS handshakes.

data.label: Linux & Windows Security
data.description: Audit file permissions, SUID binaries, Active Directory Kerberos auth, system audit logs, and privilege escalation vectors.
data.codeSnippet:
# Linux SUID Privilege Escalation Enumeration
find / -perm -u=s -type f 2>/dev/null

data.label: Web Security (OWASP Top 10)
data.description: Identify and defend against SQL Injection (SQLi), Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), CSRF, SSRF, IDOR, and Broken Access Control.

data.label: Applied Cryptography & PKI
data.description: Symmetric ciphers (AES-GCM), Asymmetric keys (RSA, ECC), digital signatures, TLS certificates, and cryptographic hash functions (SHA-256).
data.codeSnippet:
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
key = AESGCM.generate_key(bit_length=256)
aesgcm = AESGCM(key)
nonce = b"123456789012"
ciphertext = aesgcm.encrypt(nonce, b"Confidential Payload", None)

data.label: Penetration Testing & Red Teaming
data.description: Reconnaissance (Nmap, Shodan), vulnerability scanning, exploit frameworks (Metasploit), and post-exploitation reporting.
data.codeSnippet:
# Nmap Service & Vulnerability Detection Scan

data.label: Blue Team Defense & SIEM
data.description: Incident response, SIEM log analysis (Splunk, Elastic SIEM), threat hunting, EDR detection rules (Sigma/YARA), and firewall rule configuration.
